What we do

Roofing services in Bristol

From a slipped tile to a full re-roof, and the small jobs that stop a big bill later.

Roof Repairs

Slipped tiles, leaks, storm damage and failed flashing put right, usually in a single visit.

New Roofs and Re-roofing

Stripped back to the timbers and rebuilt with new membrane, treated battens and fresh tiles or slates.

Flat Roofing

Fibreglass, EPDM rubber and felt systems for extensions, garages, porches and dormers.

Chimneys and Leadwork

Repointing, rebuilds, cowls and new lead flashing where the old work has let water in.

Fascias, Soffits and Guttering

UPVC replacements and gutter repairs that stop water tracking back into the brickwork.

Moss Removal and Maintenance

Roof cleaning, gutter clearing and the small fixes that keep an older roof going.

Before and after

Real transformations

The first clip plays on its own. Drag the handle on the others to see how each roof started and how it was left.

Project 01

Full re-roof on a detached house

The original roof was at the end of its life: moss across every slope, tiles of different ages and a covering that had been patched more than once. The whole roof was stripped and re-covered in new grey interlocking tiles from eaves to ridge, with both chimney stacks left tidy at the finish.

Full strip and re-tileNew ridge and vergesBoth chimneysPhotographed by drone
Before
After
Project 02

Chimney stack taken down and rebuilt

This stack had gone past the point where repointing would have saved it. It was taken down to sound brickwork, rebuilt course by course, capped off and finished with a new pot and cowl, with the lead at the base dressed in so it stays dry.

Taken down to sound brickRebuilt in new brickNew cappingPot, cowl and lead
Before
After
Project 03

Rear extension roof stripped and re-tiled

The old covering came off this rear extension, the roof was re-battened and new grey tiles went on to match the main house. The rooflight was fitted back in and new black fascia and guttering finished the front edge.

Stripped to the timbersRe-battenedNew tilesFascia and guttering

Why choose us

Done properly, and you can see it

Most of a roof is out of sight. These are the habits that make the difference a few winters on.

Free honest quotes

We look at the actual roof, tell you what it needs and what can wait, and put it in writing. No pressure.

Photographs of the work

You see what was wrong and what was done, even on the parts of the roof you cannot get to yourself.

The whole roof, not just the tiles

Battens, membrane, leadwork, fascias and guttering, so the job is finished properly rather than half done.

Clean and tidy

Sheeted down, cleared up and the drive swept before we leave.

Straight answers

If a repair can wait, we say so. If it cannot, we say that too, and tell you what happens if it is left.

Genuinely local

Based in Bristol and working across the surrounding areas, so we are close by if you need us back.

About us

Bristol Shield Roofing

A Bristol based roofing business covering the city and the surrounding areas. Repairs, re-roofs, flat roofs, chimneys and guttering, handled by the same people from the first look at the roof to the final sweep up.

Every photograph on this page is our own work. From a chimney stack rebuilt course by course to a detached house re-roofed from eaves to ridge, it is the same standard whatever the size of the job.
